title: Locate and Identify 'codespace' Heading Element(s)
description: Find all instances of the 'codespace' heading in the codebase, focusing on app/page.tsx and app/dashboard/page.tsx, and determine the relevant React component(s) and HTML tag(s) used.
details: Search for the string 'codespace' within the app/ directory, especially in app/page.tsx and app/dashboard/page.tsx. Identify the exact HTML element (e.g., <h1>, <h2>) and its current Tailwind CSS className. Confirm whether the heading appears in multiple locations or is reused via a component. Document the findings before proceeding to modification.
test_strategy: Verify that all instances of the 'codespace' heading are found and their locations are noted. No visual changes expected at this stage.

title: Update Tailwind CSS Font Size for Heading
description: Modify the Tailwind CSS class on the 'codespace' heading element(s) to use a smaller font size, ensuring consistency with the project's design system.
details: Replace the current Tailwind font-size utility (e.g., text-4xl) with a smaller one (e.g., text-3xl or as appropriate) on the identified heading element(s). Ensure the semantic HTML tag remains correct for accessibility. If the heading appears in multiple places, update all relevant instances for consistency.
test_strategy: Run the development server and visually confirm that the heading is smaller. Check that the semantic tag (e.g., <h1>) is unchanged. Compare before/after screenshots if available.

title: Validate Responsiveness and Visual Hierarchy
description: Check the updated heading across different screen sizes to ensure the new font size maintains proper visual hierarchy and does not disrupt the layout.
details: Manually test the landing page and dashboard (if applicable) on mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints. Confirm that the smaller heading remains readable, does not overlap or break layout, and fits within the overall typographic hierarchy. Adjust the font size if necessary to optimize for all breakpoints using responsive Tailwind classes (e.g., text-2xl md:text-3xl).
test_strategy: Resize the browser window and use device emulation tools to check the heading's appearance on various screen sizes. Ensure no layout or readability issues are introduced.

title: Commit and Document the Change
description: Commit the updated code with a clear, descriptive message and document the change if necessary for future reference.
details: Stage the modified file(s), write a commit message such as 'Reduce font size of codespace heading for improved visual hierarchy', and push the change. If the project uses a changelog or documentation for UI changes, update accordingly.
test_strategy: Verify that the commit includes only the intended changes and that the application builds and runs successfully after the update.
